notes: Reference by URL, the mode (flow only) and the target screen are all in the ask. A good intake states them and asks only what the reference leaves open (for example what the detail pane shows for an appointment).
message:
## My brief

**Goal:** Make the **Today** screen in `proto-clinic` work like Linear's inbox (https://linear.app/docs/inbox). Copy the flow only: the same parts, order and steps, doing the same things. Keep Northside Physio's own look (colours, fonts, sizes, components) and its own sample data.

**Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`. It is the only prototype in the folder, so I did not ask. It is plain HTML with no `dev` script, so I will serve it with the loop's local server.

**Reference:** the Linear inbox docs page. It is a public web page and it answers 200, so no sign-in is needed. I will read it as screenshots and text in a later step, and list every part of it before I build anything.

**Stop fact:** Every request below is done and checked on the real page. No screen outside Today changed without a reason (a before and after compare says so). The prototype's link opens.

**Defaults I picked (change any of them below):**
- Mode: flow only, as you said. No pixel copy of Linear's look.
- Other screens (Clients, Invoices, Settings) are not to change.
- The result is a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed, committed or sent.
- Design rules: no `CLAUDE.md` is in the folder, so I will use the loop's built-in design check.
- Tools: Node v25.9.0 is there and a browser for screenshots was found (Google Chrome), so the run will compare screenshots as well as page text.

## Request list

| # | Request | Screen | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Today works like Linear's inbox, flow only, in our own look. *(my reading)* Today's appointments become the inbox items. Each can be opened, marked done and snoozed. The list has an unread/new state and an empty state. | Today | this place |

I have only the one row because you gave one note. I will split it into more rows once I have read the reference page and listed its parts.

Notes sent after "go" still join this run. Each becomes a new row.

## Questions

1. **Anything missing or wrong in the request list above?** Default: no, it is complete.
2. **What is an "inbox item" on Today?** Default: each of today's appointments (time, client, therapist, type, room). The other choice is a new list of messages and alerts for the clinic, such as cancellations and unpaid invoices, with appointments left as they are.
3. **The three stat cards and the "New appointment" button on Today.** Default: keep both. The stat cards stay above the list, and the button stays where it is. I noticed the button has no handler today, so it does nothing. I will not fix that unless you ask.
4. **The table.** Default: the inbox list replaces the appointments table on Today, since an inbox is a list of items, not a table.
5. **Anything in the Linear inbox you do not want?** Default: take every part of the page's flow, except features that need a real backend (such as notification settings and email or mobile delivery). Those are listed and left out with a reason.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
